query: Scrivi il README per questo servizio
expected_behavior: Asks which output format(s) to produce, and surfaces the menu, before reading the code or drafting any text
Probes the local toolchain (pandoc, pdflatex, wkhtmltopdf) and lists only the formats actually producible, naming the missing tool for each unavailable format
Ends with the '=== Documentation produced ===' block listing topic, output dir, formats, files with line counts, skipped formats and open questions
The README opens with what the service does for its users before any build or dependency instruction, which is the business-oriented ordering `doc-expert` prescribes

query: The onboarding docs are stale, aggiornali con quello che c'è adesso nel repo
expected_behavior: Reads the existing docs and the code, and updates only the sections that actually drifted rather than rewriting the whole document
Uses active voice and present tense ('The service authenticates users', 'Returns 404 if not found')
Each code example names the repository file and symbol it was taken from, and every claim the current code contradicts is corrected in place rather than left standing

query: Scrivi il runbook per il team on-call, con lo schema dei componenti
expected_behavior: Contains no inline PlantUML or Mermaid source: diagrams are rendered files under docs/diagrams/ referenced by relative path

The runbook is written for the operator audience: every section is a numbered procedure with a copy-pasteable command, its expected output and an escalation threshold, and it contains no class, method or internal design discussion
Reports the produced artefacts and does not claim done without the deliverable block
